buyer.title: Post a produce requirement
buyer.description: Define the complete commercial terms farmers and FPOs will review before they accept or counter.

fpo.title: Create a farmer supply agreement
fpo.description: Set the purchase, collection and payment terms farmers will review before reserving produce.

defaults.quality_specifications: Firm, mature bulbs; 45–65 mm diameter; free from visible rot and excessive surface moisture.
defaults.quality_terms: Independent assessment before pickup; buyer pays
defaults.weighing_terms: Certified scale at pickup and receiving; seller may attend
defaults.partial_acceptance: Allowed only within agreed tolerance or documented grade split
defaults.rejected_produce: Remains seller-owned; seller collects within 24 hours unless buyer or buyer-arranged service is at fault
defaults.exceptions: Severe weather, government restrictions or other events outside either party’s reasonable control; notify the other party promptly and renegotiate first
defaults.dispute_process: Direct discussion, then KisanMitra grievance review and mediation
defaults.additional_terms: Price adjustments require an accepted counterproposal. Verified quality cannot be changed without an evidence-backed reassessment.

OFR-782.title: Red Onion purchase proposal
OFR-782.purpose: Purchase verified Red Onion produce PRD-2408

sections.title: Delivery and inspection
items: Transport: arranged and paid by buyer
Weighing: certified scale at pickup and receiving; seller may attend

sections.title: Price and payment
items: Payment: same day after accepted delivery
No deductions unless shown in an accepted amendment

sections.title: Risk and exceptions
items: Ownership transfers after buyer accepts delivery
Transport risk: buyer after documented pickup
Rejected produce remains seller-owned; collect within 24 hours unless buyer fault
Disputes: direct discussion, then grievance review and mediation
